Round 3 (r4, focused) verified the three wording fixes landed exactly as declared with no other drift across the 40-path write set, per-attempt artifact templates and dev@66b2d44 baseline pin, and re-ran all structural checks itself. Verdict: READY_TO_FREEZE.
